description: Submit a proposed action to Intended for a governed decision (ALLOW / ESCALATE / DENY). Intended decides and records; it does not run the action — you do, and only on ALLOW, attaching the signed single-use authority token returned with it. On ESCALATE, do not perform the action yet: call check_decision with the returned intentId to wait for the human approver. Fail-closed. If the result carries inputQuality, the action text did not name an action: rephrase it as the hint says and resubmit.

action.description: The action to take, as a verb phrase, e.g. "Send renewal reminder email". Not a status or an alert.

actorId.description: Identity of the acting agent (for attribution/scoping).

args.description: Details of the action (ids, counts, recipients), evaluated by policy and stored only as a digest.

targetSystem.description: The system acted on, e.g. "stripe/subscriptions". Recorded as "unspecified" when omitted.

name: submit_intent
title: Submit an intent for an authority decision
